text:
You need someone who can support customers on demand, improve Google Analytics/Data Studio setups, and turn performance data into clear next steps.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. In a Marketing attribution analysis project for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery and built a Looker Studio view to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work led to 18% of ad budget reallocated and customer acquisition cost down 12% the next quarter.

I’m comfortable working through data issues, spotting what’s missing in a setup, and suggesting practical improvements. I can help customers with dashboards, actionable analysis, and ongoing technical support.

How much of your current customer work is focused on GA4/Data Studio troubleshooting versus recommending performance marketing improvements?
